en.headline: Hong Kong October exports surge 65.6 percent on AI-related goods
en.dek: Census and Statistics Department figures showed exports rose to HK$764.5 billion and imports by 56.2 percent, driven by sustained strong demand for AI electronic products.
body: Hong Kong's merchandise exports rose 65.6 percent year on year in October to HK$764.5 billion, the Census and Statistics Department said on Thursday. The growth rate accelerated from 64.9 percent in September and marked the 21st consecutive month of double-digit expansion.

Imports grew 56.2 percent to HK$783.8 billion, leaving a visible trade deficit of HK$19.3 billion, or 2.5 percent of the value of imports. For the first 10 months of 2026, exports were up 47.4 percent and imports 46.2 percent year on year, with a cumulative deficit of HK$438.5 billion.

A government spokesman said the further sharp growth in October was driven by sustained strong exports of AI-related electronic products, while exports of other products also accelerated. Exports to most major markets rose significantly across all commodity categories.

Looking ahead, the spokesman said robust global AI investment and related demand would continue to support Hong Kong's merchandise trade performance. However, external uncertainties persisted, including developments in international trade and technology policy, risks associated with the rapid expansion of global AI investment, and evolving geopolitical situations.

zh.headline: 本港10月出口按年大升65.6% 受人工智能相關電子產品帶動
zh.dek: 統計處公布10月出口貨值7645億元，進口升56.2%，有形貿易逆差193億元；首10個月出口升47.4%。
body: 政府統計處周四公布，本港10月整體出口貨值按年上升65.6%至7645億元，升幅較9月的64.9%加快，並已連續21個月錄得雙位數增長。
同月進口貨值升56.2%至7838億元，錄得有形貿易逆差193億元，相等於進口貨值的2.5%。今年首10個月，出口按年升47.4%，進口升46.2%，累計有形貿易逆差4385億元。
政府發言人表示，受人工智能相關電子產品的出口持續強勁帶動，10月商品出口以貨值計進一步大幅增長，其他產品的出口亦加快。所有商品類別合計，輸往大部分主要市場的出口均錄得顯著上升。
發言人展望，全球蓬勃的人工智能投資及相關需求將繼續支持香港的商品貿易表現。然而，外圍不確定因素持續，包括國際貿易和科技政策的發展、環球人工智能投資快速擴張所涉及的相關風險，以及地緣政治局勢的演變。
